ex.en: Turn on two-factor authentication to protect your account.
ex.zh: 開啟雙重驗證來保護你的帳號。

ex.en: The app uses fingerprint authentication.
ex.zh: 這個 App 使用指紋驗證。

ex.en: Automation has replaced many factory jobs.
ex.zh: 自動化取代了許多工廠的工作。

ex.en: We use automation to send reminder emails.
ex.zh: 我們用自動化的方式寄送提醒郵件。

ex.en: You are not authorized to enter there.
ex.zh: 你沒有權限進入那裡。

ex.en: Is it true that you authorized the driver to take the car home?
ex.zh: 你真的批准司機把車開回家嗎？

ex.en: Only managers can authorize refunds.
ex.zh: 只有經理可以批准退款。

ex.en: China's health authorities are taking steps to stop the spread of the coronavirus.
ex.zh: 中國衛生當局正在採取措施阻止冠狀病毒擴散。

ex.en: It is necessary to obtain the sanction of the authorities to enter this building.
ex.zh: 要進入這棟大樓，必須取得當局的許可。

ex.en: The local authorities have closed the road.
ex.zh: 地方當局已經封閉了這條路。

ex.en: On what authority are you making us go?
ex.zh: 你憑什麼要我們走？

ex.en: Only the manager has the authority to approve this.
ex.zh: 只有經理有權核准這件事。

ex.en: The doctor is a great authority on children's diseases.
ex.zh: 那位醫生是兒童疾病的權威。

ex.en: He is a great authority on economics.
ex.zh: 他是經濟學的權威。

ex.en: This factory produces 500 automobiles a day.
ex.zh: 這家工廠每天生產五百輛汽車。

ex.en: Automobiles are made in factories.
ex.zh: 汽車是在工廠裡製造的。

ex.en: Bicycles traveling to the right of automobiles is illegal.
ex.zh: 腳踏車在汽車右側行駛是違法的。

auto.zh: 汽車（多用於修飾語，如 auto industry）

ex.en: He works in the auto industry.
ex.zh: 他在汽車業工作。

ex.en: The auto parts store is next to the gas station.
ex.zh: 汽車零件行就在加油站旁邊。

ex.en: Set the camera to auto mode.
ex.zh: 把相機設為自動模式。

ex.en: Turn on auto save so you don't lose your work.
ex.zh: 開啟自動儲存，以免工作內容遺失。

ex.en: Each day our life becomes more comfortable and more automated.
ex.zh: 我們的生活一天比一天更舒適、更自動化。

ex.en: This is an automated payphone; you use it by inserting a coin.
ex.zh: 這是自動投幣式公用電話，投硬幣就可以打。

ex.en: We plan to automate the billing process.
ex.zh: 我們打算把請款流程自動化。

ex.en: The doors at the entrance are automatic.
ex.zh: 入口的門是自動門。

ex.en: The system sends an automatic reply.
ex.zh: 系統會自動回覆。

ex.en: Saying 'thank you' has become automatic for him.
ex.zh: 說「謝謝」對他來說已經成了反射動作。

ex.en: Breathing is an automatic process.
ex.zh: 呼吸是一種自動進行的過程。

ex.en: I knew it would be hot in the auditorium.
ex.zh: 我就知道禮堂裡會很熱。

ex.en: The ceremony will be held in the school auditorium.
ex.zh: 典禮將在學校禮堂舉行。

ex.en: The unclaimed items were sold off at auction.
ex.zh: 無人認領的物品被拍賣掉了。

ex.en: The painting sold at auction for a million dollars.
ex.zh: 這幅畫在拍賣會上以一百萬元售出。

ex.en: The unclaimed items were auctioned off.
ex.zh: 無人認領的物品被拍賣了。

ex.en: They auctioned the old furniture online.
ex.zh: 他們在網路上拍賣舊家具。

ex.en: I have an audition today.
ex.zh: 我今天有一場試鏡。

ex.en: She has an audition for a musical next week.
ex.zh: 她下週要參加一齣音樂劇的試鏡。

ex.en: He auditioned for the lead role.
ex.zh: 他去試鏡主角。

ex.en: Hundreds of singers auditioned for the show.
ex.zh: 數百名歌手參加了這個節目的試鏡。

ex.en: He works in the automotive industry.
ex.zh: 他在汽車業工作。

ex.en: The company makes automotive parts for export.
ex.zh: 這家公司生產外銷的汽車零件。

ex.en: Employees want more autonomy at work.
ex.zh: 員工希望工作上有更多自主權。

ex.en: Each branch has a degree of autonomy.
ex.zh: 每間分公司都有一定的自主權。

autonomous.zh: 自主的、自治的；自動（駕駛）的

ex.en: Each department is autonomous in its hiring decisions.
ex.zh: 各部門在招聘上可以自行決定。

ex.en: Autonomous cars may become common within ten years.
ex.zh: 自動駕駛車可能在十年內普及。

ex.en: The audio quality of this video is poor.
ex.zh: 這部影片的音質很差。

ex.en: Please check your audio settings before the online meeting.
ex.zh: 線上會議前請先檢查音訊設定。

ex.en: This book also comes with an audio version.
ex.zh: 這本書也有有聲版。

ex.en: Richard Roberts is the author of numerous books.
ex.zh: 理查·羅伯茨寫了很多本書。

ex.en: I have read many modern authors.
ex.zh: 我讀過許多現代作家的作品。

ex.en: That Italian author is little known in Japan.
ex.zh: 那位義大利作家在日本不太有名。

ex.en: If you press this button the window opens automatically.
ex.zh: 按下這個按鈕，窗戶就會自動打開。

ex.en: All plans automatically renew until cancelled.
ex.zh: 所有方案在取消前都會自動續約。

ex.en: My computer shut down automatically.
ex.zh: 我的電腦自動關機了。

ex.en: I automatically reached for my phone when I woke up.
ex.zh: 我一醒來就下意識地去拿手機。

ex.en: She automatically said yes without thinking.
ex.zh: 她想都沒想就答應了。

aunt.zh: 阿姨、姑姑、舅媽、伯母、嬸嬸

ex.en: This doll is a gift from my aunt.
ex.zh: 這個洋娃娃是我阿姨送我的禮物。

ex.en: My aunt made a new skirt for me.
ex.zh: 我阿姨幫我做了一條新裙子。

ex.en: My aunt grows tomatoes in her garden.
ex.zh: 我阿姨在她的花園裡種番茄。

ex.en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in autumn.
ex.zh: 這些綠葉到了秋天會變紅或變黃。

ex.en: Autumn came and the leaves started to fall.
ex.zh: 秋天到了，樹葉也開始落下。

ex.en: In autumn, some animals store food away for the winter.
ex.zh: 有些動物會在秋天為冬季儲藏食物。

ex.en: The government introduced austerity measures to cut debt.
ex.zh: 政府推出撙節措施以減少債務。

ex.en: Many people protested against austerity.
ex.zh: 許多人抗議緊縮政策。

ex.en: You need authorization to access this file.
ex.zh: 你需要授權才能存取這個檔案。

ex.en: No one may enter without written authorization.
ex.zh: 未經書面許可，任何人不得進入。

ex.en: The company has an audit every year.
ex.zh: 公司每年都要接受稽核。

ex.en: The audit found several errors in the accounts.
ex.zh: 稽核發現帳目有好幾處錯誤。

ex.en: An outside firm audits our accounts.
ex.zh: 我們的帳目由外部公司查核。

ex.en: I'm auditing a history class this semester.
ex.zh: 我這學期旁聽一門歷史課。

ex.en: The auditors will visit our office next week.
ex.zh: 稽核人員下週會來我們辦公室。

ex.en: An independent auditor checked the accounts.
ex.zh: 一位獨立的查帳員檢查了帳目。

ex.en: Are there authentic Chinese restaurants in France?
ex.zh: 法國有道地的中餐廳嗎？

ex.en: I really hope that I can speak authentic Chinese.
ex.zh: 我很希望可以說一口地道的中文。

ex.en: Is this painting authentic?
ex.zh: 這幅畫是真跡嗎？

ex.en: The museum confirmed that the letter is authentic.
ex.zh: 博物館證實那封信是真的。

ex.en: The whole audience got up and started to applaud.
ex.zh: 所有的觀眾都站起來鼓掌。

ex.en: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
ex.zh: 觀眾大多是年紀很小的孩子。

ex.en: Among the audience, there were students, teachers, clerks, and so on.
ex.zh: 聽眾裡有學生、老師、上班族等等。

ex.en: Who is the target audience for this ad?
ex.zh: 這支廣告的目標族群是誰？

ex.en: Her videos have a large audience in Asia.
ex.zh: 她的影片在亞洲有廣大的觀眾。
